activity.role: Pine Tree chief and military leader
activity.notes: Skenandoa (also Shenandoah/Oskanondonha) was a respected elected Oneida chief and military leader. During the American Revolutionary War he played a major role in the Oneida decision to support the American side and led Oneida/Tuscarora forces. Because no secure full chiefship interval is preserved, ATLAS uses the Revolutionary War as the bounded representative leadership period.

sources.title: Reverend Samuel Kirkland — Fort Stanwix National Monument
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service identifies Skenandoa as a respected Oneida chief and Kirkland's close Oneida associate.

sources.title: Bicentennial Colleges Educate, Enlighten and Entertain — Hamilton College
sources.citation_text: Hamilton College records that Skenandoa played a major role in the Oneida alliance with the colonists during the American Revolutionary War.
